name: SEATTLE      WA
summary: Anthony Collins called Gotmolz to report that a trapped mole was caught in one of their snares in his yard and was actively struggling. The agent confirmed the account under Amy Collins at 21449 94th Place South and advised the customer to wait for the mole to calm down rather than attempt to kill it with a shovel, to avoid damaging the trap. The agent indicated no technician was available in the area immediately but would try to send someone the next day, with a scheduled return visit planned for the 16th to retrieve the trap and mole.

name: YOUNG,HARUO
summary: Customer called to request a quote for residential mole control services in University Place, zip code 98466. Agent Mo explained two service options: a one-time quick fix for $450 (with $150 deposit) that guarantees catching existing moles over five weeks, or a yearly Total Mold Control Program (TMCP) at $100/month with unlimited visits and no upfront payment but requiring a 12-month commitment. Agent emphasized that mole control is typically a lifetime service due to territorial behavior and the extensive tunnel systems they create, and noted that the company services the area on Wednesdays. Customer decided to think it over and discuss with family before making a decision, with plans to follow up.
